title: Does not heat very well
text: Does not heat very well. Clean design, and minimalist, but it does you no good if it does not heat properly. after a few months of using, I can say it does not keep your drink warm/hot.  It keeps your drink lukewarm.  I want to be able to use my normal everyday mug and not the one it comes with it.  This is not a happy buy sadly. unless your drink cup a flat bottom it won't heat properly expcept for the  outer dianeter.
